in_urdu.name: Mushaywir
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Those who cover or protect
in_urdu.long_meaning: Mushaywir ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ In the Battle of Badr, the Mushaywir were a group of Ansar who hid their families in their houses and protected them from the enemy. This name is a reminder of their courage, selflessness, and dedication to protect their loved ones.
